title: Out for the day. Mrs Florence MacCabe, relict of the late Patk MacCabe, deeply lamented, of Bride Street. One of her sisterhood lugged me squealing into life
html_source: The ineluctable modality of the visible held for Stephen as the women come down the stairs but he quickly leaves the world he can see for an imagined version he concocts of these women – he makes it all up in other words.
